messages:
alex: Heads up — this morning an enterprise customer hit a quota cap and the gateway silently routed them from model:rl-2.1 -> model:mini-quant to avoid errors. Their QA flagged quality regressions. Need better audit and a reason header so customers can triage.
jamie: timeline? which project and which rule triggered?
alex: around 09:12 UTC, project acme-payments, route match path:/v1/generate. I can paste sample headers we saw in the proxy logs.
alex: example header seen in proxy: X-Used-Model: mini-quant; note: no decision_reason field so we couldn't tell it was a quota override.
sara: console currently only shows final model id per request, not why it was chosen. we need a decision_reason telemetry field AND an opt-in per-tenant audit stream.
ben: agree. also we must be careful not to log PII into audit. sample approach: header X-Redwood-Route-Decision with values like override=quota;from=rl-2.1;to=mini-quant;bucket=project:acme-payments
jamie: +1. UI idea: show per-route breakdown in the console (percent fallback, top reasons) and allow admins to flip a toggle to "deny on quota" vs "fallback on quota" so teams can opt into strict enforcement.
alex: What about backwards compatibility? prefer header to be added only when a routing override happens (don't spam every request). also default retention for audit should be shorter unless customer opts in.
infra-bot: deploy-preview created for feature branch routing-audit/v2 — link: https://ci.internal/review/1423 :white_check_mark:
ben: proposed rule snippet to implement audit header and sampling:
```json
{
  "match": "path:/v1/generate",
  "when": {"quota_exceeded": true},
  "action": {"type": "fallback", "target": "mini-quant", "reason_header": "X-Redwood-Route-Decision"}
}
```
(sampling param and pii-scrubber applied at the proxy layer)
sara: also include quota bucket id in the header so support can correlate: add bucket=acme-payments-rl to the value.
jamie: ops alert suggestion: fire when fallback rate > 5% for a route over 10m window. add linked graph in console per-route.
alex: cool. action items: (1) eng-platform to add header + sampling + pii scrubber (ben), (2) console to show reason breakdown and fallback graph (jamie), (3) support to document what to look for and add runbook (sara). I'll file tickets.
ben: will start a PR for proxy header emit and scrubber.
sara: I'll draft the runbook and sample queries for logs.
alex: thanks — let's sync tomorrow at 10 for rollout plan. :thumbsup:
